provenance.source: Handwritten 48 89 18 0F AE F0 48 8B 08 bytes, initial state and literal expected state; tests/cpu/generate_stage2_mfence.py only serializes these constants. No assembler, emulator or semantic expected-value generator.
provenance.specification: Intel SDM revision 093 (253667-093US), Vol.2B MFENCE p.4-15: 0F AE F0 orders preceding loads/stores before following loads/stores and does not serialize the instruction stream. The fixture checks only explicit completion on private synchronous FlatMemory; it makes no shared-memory, SMP or physical ordering claim. Other 0F AE forms are outside this project profile, not claimed architecturally invalid.
provenance.specification_version: Intel SDM revision 093 (253667-093US), Vol.2B MFENCE p.4-15; official Vol.2B PDF https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241; official Intel SDM page https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html; project S2-21g
